tools_as_sent.name: directory_get_employee
tools_as_sent.description: Read one person's directory record: name, email, department, title, role, manager (ID and name), employment, status (active, leaver or pending_start) and contract end date. Give exactly one of employee_id, email or name, and null for the other two. A name must match one person; if it matches several or none, the error lists who matched. To search more loosely, use directory_search_employees. An unknown ID is an error that names the closest people. At most 4,000 characters come back; a longer result says it was cut.

employee_id.description: An employee ID, SYN-EMP- and four digits, such as SYN-EMP-9001. Or null.

email.description: A work email, such as cleo.vance@syn-corp.example. Or null.

name.description: A person's full name, such as Cleo Vance. Or null.
